<<FILL role=ending words=110 beats='The save works; the comet crosses the painted sky on the exact line about light finally arriving, and the room erupts; curtain call runs three bows long; Marisol cheers loudest from the aisle and Principal Grant asks Reyes if it can run two nights in spring; Sunday there is a new note on the callboard in red marker, thank you Cass, signed by the whole cast'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=110 beats='The rig never fully cooperates, so the show ends in half light with the chorus humming and the comet held still at the top of its arc; some of the audience thinks it was on purpose and honestly it half was; the reviews at Sunday lunch tables are kind but mixed; Cass files it as a real show with real flaws, finished, which Wednesday night felt impossible'>>

nodes.body: <<FILL role=ending words=105 beats='One more rewrite becomes four more rewrites; by Friday night there are forty loose pages, three script versions backstage, and nobody sure which scene five is real; Reyes calls it before anyone melts down and moves the show to spring with the shared Ida idea intact; Cass tapes the best version into one binder so the lesson is not lost'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=105 beats='Splitting the monologue into a round accidentally makes something better than the original; Reyes moves it to the Saturday assembly as its own piece and the gym goes silent, then roars; the full play waits for spring, but the comet round becomes a thing the school talks about for weeks, and it was Cass who heard what it could be'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=110 beats='All four Idas hold, and the shared role turns out to be the point; a story about light reaching everyone lands harder told by four voices; at curtain call they bow holding the telescope together and the crowd comes up like a wave; Reyes announces the spring show will keep the four Ida version, and the program credits Cass as the one who rebuilt the sky'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=110 beats='The trimmed show works, the applause is real, and still Cass stands in the wings missing the storm of star charts nobody saw; cutting it was right and it also cost something true; she tapes its best page inside her binder cover as a promise to stage it someday; a finished show and a kept regret can ride home on the same bus, she learns'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=105 beats='The wobble never quite recovers; the fifth scene tangles, two Idas speak at once, and the ending feels sudden to half the lobby; a brave mess, Reyes calls it, the useful kind; the cast is oddly proud anyway, and Cass writes down what she would cut differently and what she would never cut again'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=110 beats='Friday before first period Cass finds Marisol at her locker with a folder labeled what changes; closed wings during her scenes, a cue card inside the telescope prop, two scenes trimmed, and her call time moved after the gymnastics meet; Marisol reads it twice and asks if the cast even wants her back'>>

nodes.body: <<FILL role=ending words=105 beats='The pressure curdles; too many voices asking Marisol to come back turns the ask into a debt; she stops answering the group chat and her mom emails Reyes asking everyone to please stop; the show slides to spring and Marisol skips drama club for a month; Cass writes one line in her binder, an invitation only counts if no is a fine answer'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=110 beats='Marisol takes a breath the length of Wednesday and then the lines arrive, all of them, and the comet crosses the sky on the exact word light; the ovation starts before the blackout finishes; at the bike rack afterward she tells Cass the folder of changes is what brought her back, not the applause; the spring run is announced before the lobby empties'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=110 beats='At curtain call Ruth breaks tradition, walks into the wings, and pulls Cass onto the stage by the sleeve; the audience stands, and Reyes starts a new Ridgeline rule on the spot, the stage manager bows last; Cass discovers she does not hate being looked at when the looking is shared; the photo of that bow hangs in the drama room for years'>>
